scoring_justification: Checker recomputes expected B, tricritical point, and wing critical point from the same publicly‑stated model parameters and checks agreement within tolerances.

outputs.description: Cubic coefficient B at four pressures (P=0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 GPa) evaluated at T=Tc(P).
Tricritical point coordinates (pressure, temperature) where A=0 and B=0 simultaneously.
Wing critical point at P=1.4 GPa (temperature, magnetic field, reduced magnetization).

output_contract.notes: All outputs are derived from the exchange-striction Landau model with given material parameters. The agent must implement the formulas for Tc(P), B, and C as described in the steps. The checker will compare against independently computed reference values and the paper's reported gold (with tolerance).

steps.description: Cubic coefficient B at four pressures evaluated at T=Tc(P).
Wing critical point at P=1.4 GPa (T_cr, H_cr, m_cr).
